messages.subject: Multinomial logistic regression with random effects
parts:
What's the best package/way to run a multinomial logistic regression with two random effects? I have a categorical dependent variable with three levels, a handful of fixed effects (both continuous and categorical), and two random effects (speaker and lexical item).
lme4::glmer()
has a
family
argument, but it doesn't take "multinominal" (despite taking "binomial").

I'm wading into waters I haven't tread before.

Thanks.
